content.summary: Koninklijke Philips (ENXTAM:PHIA) has turned profitable in its latest 12-month results through September 2025, despite being impacted by a one-off non-recurring loss of €446.0 million. Over the past five years, earnings have declined by 34.8% per year, but the company is now expected to deliver 35.2% annual earnings growth, outpacing the Dutch market's 11.2% forecast.
